note: Campground and cabins on Main St (US-201) in Jackman on the Moose River, near the Quebec border and the Moose River Bow Trip. The engine describes RV 6, 7, 9, 10 and 11 as directly on the river. --Claude
summary: Confirmed open and bookable on RoverPass; stored $40 replaced by 2027 engine quotes $45-52; added 50-amp, season, weekend minimum; riverfront holds on engine wording and imagery.
flags: PRIVATE GATE: passes. Cheapest real RV night $45 (April-May 2027), $46.80 weekdays in summer; weekend nights $52 but Fri+Sat must be booked together, and the weekday nights are under $50. Operator's page still advertises $40/day. No gateway within 40 km (Quebec City 150 km). Presence passes: working site with phone 207-668-3301, claimed RoverPass booking engine.

RATINGS: Google 4.7 over 61 (Maps panel, read). Search snippets, pages not opened: RoverPass listing 4.5 over 128; Campendium no reviews; The Dyrt and RV Life not found. Campertunity's AI-labelled review summary mentions tent sites that flood, litter, limited shade, hard-to-find staff; I did not read the underlying reviews.

LONG-STAY: tests pass. Operator sells summer seasonal ($1350 Memorial Day-Columbus Day) and winter seasonal, plus monthly $720, but nightly is sold on its engine: 21 RV sites open on spring dates and 10 from June to early Oct, so about half go seasonal in summer and nightly stays well above 1 in 10. Not mostly seasonal on this evidence.

WATERFRONT: riverfront confirmed. The engine lists RV 6, 7, 9, 10, 11 as 'a single pad and is directly on the Moose River' (maxLength 40, offered on the plain RV Sites rate). Esri imagery: pads with RVs about 15-20 m from the bank at about 45.6345,-70.2642, open grass to the docks, the loop road on the landward side; river about 50 m wide at the docks. Which numbered pad is which isn't shown, no site map found.
PIN: stored pin (Google's, at the Main St frontage) is about 190 m from the loop centre at about 45.6340,-70.2637: under the 250 m line, no change proposed.
Sewer: no page or rate lists it; left unset, which means the stored derived water-only record stands. Character: operator leads with outdoor motorsport riders and snowmobile access (US-201 frontage).
